input_volts_peak.source: web: https://www.sound-au.com/articles/guitar-voltage.htm (a hot pickup peaks just under 1 V)

output_volts_peak.source: derived: the speaker voltage's peak, 53.6 V (production render, 1 kHz at 1 V peak into bright input 1, volume 0.5, 2026-10-29), rounded up for headroom

input_jack.notes: the jack the guitar is plugged into: 1 bright input 1, 2 bright input 2, 3 normal input 1, 4 normal input 2 (input 1: both 68K in parallel; input 2: the 68K / 68K divider)

volume_bright.source: sch: the bright channel's 1 MEG volume

volume_normal.source: sch: the normal channel's 1 MEG volume

mains_v_rms.source: provisional: model knowledge (US line voltage; the drawing prints none); 120 V is the replacement power transformer's rated primary (web: https://www.amplifiedparts.com/sites/default/files/associated_files/p-tgp-002.pdf)

audio_taper_mid.source: provisional: model knowledge (the drawing prints no tapers; Fender's volume and tone pots of the era are commonly given as audio taper, ~10% of the track at half rotation)

ot_sec_per_half.source: derived: 8 k CT : 8 ohm (same sheet; the original's nominal), secondary turns per primary half 2 / sqrt(8000 / 8)
ot_sec_per_half.notes: the sheet's inductances (3.67 H per half, 16.7 mH secondary, both at 1 V) give 0.0675: the secondary's 1 V is a much higher flux

ot_core_material.source: provisional: model knowledge (silicon-steel EI laminations; the only silicon steel in config/magnetics.yaml)

ot_core_area_m2.source: provisional: model knowledge (a ~7/8 in tongue in the 2-3/4 x 2-1/4 in frame of reproductions, 1 in stack (Tube Amp Doctor), 95% stacking; data/schematics/fender_5e3/README.md)

ot_core_path_m.source: provisional: model knowledge (~5.6 x the tongue width for scrapless EI)

ot_turns_half.source: provisional: model knowledge (a design rule: 1.2 T at 15 W into 8 k at 70 Hz with the core's area; the reproduction is rated 15 W, same sheet)

ot_gap_m.source: derived: gives 3.67 H per primary half in the core's linear limit with ot_turns_half (the reproduction's measured inductance at 1 kHz, 1 V, same sheet). An effective joint gap: it also stands in for the lower initial permeability of the era's non-oriented steel

ot_leakage_h.source: derived: the mean of the reproduction's leakage per primary half, 40.47 / 19.31 mH (same sheet)
ot_leakage_h.notes: the format splits leakage evenly between the windings; the measured asymmetry isn't modeled

ot_c_half_f.source: provisional: model knowledge (self-capacitance of a push-pull primary half, 100-500 pF)
